title: Best YouTube SEO Experts (2026): Video SEO That Gets Views
description: How to hire a video SEO expert for YouTube: titles, tags, descriptions, thumbnails and channel audits, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Video SEO experts help your videos get found on YouTube and in search. They research keywords, improve titles, descriptions, chapters and tags, and review your channel. Good work brings steady views from people searching for your topics. Projects go wrong when the expert promises views, uses fake engagement, or optimizes words without improving the videos people actually click. This guide helps you hire real optimization.

faq.q: Do they need access to my channel?
faq.a: For audits, read access to analytics helps. Use YouTube's permission system rather than sharing your password.

faq.q: Is buying views or subscribers part of SEO?
faq.a: No. Fake engagement breaks platform rules and can harm your channel. Never accept it.

faq.q: How long until I see results?
faq.a: New videos may show changes within weeks. Older videos and channel growth usually take longer.
